infotexts.jobdescription.robot: A robotic crew member in a protective frame.
infotexts.entitydescription.robotupgradecap: Increases maximum health by 20%, reduces blunt trauma damage by 20%, stun by 40%, and provides full immunity to concussion.
infotexts.entitydescription.robotupgradeclothes: Protective underlayer: 40% resistance to ballistic, laceration, bite, explosion and burn damage, 60% organ damage resistance, 30% electric resistance, and complete immunity to poisons, drunkenness, and nausea.
infotexts.entitydescription.robotupgradebelt: A utility belt with one dedicated fuel-rod slot that slowly restores the rod's condition and two small-item slots. It occupies the Bag slot and cannot be worn with a standard toolbelt.
infotexts.entitydescription.thermalpatch: A rapid-acting weld patch designed to seal structural damage on a robotic chassis. Restores chassis integrity based on mechanical skill. Applying it directly to living flesh causes severe thermal burns.
infotexts.talentdescription.robotbeltresistance: Also grants 20% resistance to blunt trauma.
infotexts.talentdescription.robot_crafter_tier1: Tools and reactor fuel rods you fabricate are of higher quality (+1 quality level).
infotexts.talentdescription.robot_crafter_weapons: Weapons you fabricate are of higher quality (+1 quality level).
infotexts.talentdescription.robot_crafter_power: Mobile batteries you fabricate are of higher quality (+1 quality level).
infotexts.talentdescription.robot_crafter_refiner: When deconstructing raw ores and minerals, you have a [chance]% chance to extract double the materials.
infotexts.entitydescription.robotmodule_speed: Hardware coprocessor for the internal bus. Increases movement and swimming speed by 5%.
infotexts.entitydescription.robotmodule_armor: Hardware coprocessor for the internal bus. Increases physical damage resistance by 3%.
infotexts.entitydescription.robotmodule_melee: Hardware coprocessor for the internal bus. Increases melee damage by 20%.
infotexts.entitydescription.robotmodule_ranged: Hardware coprocessor for the internal bus. Increases handheld ranged weapon damage by 8%.
infotexts.entitydescription.robotmodule_repair: Hardware coprocessor for the internal bus. Provides 0.1 HP/s passive chassis self-repair.
infotexts.entitydescription.robotmodule_efficiency: Increases maximum health by 10% per installed module.
infotexts.talentdescription.robot_modules_tier1: Unlocks fabrication of two modules and a headset with two module sockets.
infotexts.talentdescription.robot_modules_combat: Unlocks fabrication of the Melee and Ballistics modules. Choosing this branch locks System Protocols.
infotexts.talentdescription.robot_modules_system: Unlocks fabrication of the Auto-Repair and Chassis Reinforcement modules. Choosing this branch locks Combat Protocols.
infotexts.talentdescription.robot_modules_tier3: Unlocks an expanded headset with three module sockets. Wear it instead of the basic module interface.
infotexts.talentdescription.robot_modules_overcloc: Boosts servo, armor, melee, ballistics, and repair module effects by 50%, and unlocks the overclocked Chassis Reinforcement Module.
infotexts.entitydescription.robotmodule_interface: A headset with two sockets for robot modules. The slots are available while the interface is worn.
infotexts.entitydescription.robotmodule_expansion: A headset with three sockets for robot modules. Unlocked by the Expansion Bus talent and replaces the basic interface.
infotexts.entitydescription.robotmodule_efficiency: Increases maximum health by 10% per installed module.
